import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
import { getFirstRechargeInfoData } from '@src/response-apps/recharge/firstRechargeInfo/app';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { addOptions, FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { Format, logger, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';

/**
 * 礼包奖励信息指令
 * 查看礼包奖励档位状态和领取进度
 * 指令格式：/礼包奖励
 */
export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;
  const uid = e.uid as number;

  try {
    const result = await getFirstRechargeInfoData(uid, bid);

    if (result.code === 'FAILED') {
      const md = Format.createMarkdown();

      md.addText('查询失败，请稍后再试。');

      void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));

      return;
    }

    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addBold('【礼包奖励】');
    md.addNewline();
    md.addBold('【奖励档位】');

    for (const tier of result.tiers) {
      md.addNewline();

      if (tier.status === 'claimable') {
        md.addText(`${tier.tierAmountYuan}元档 `);

        addOptions(md, [{ label: '领取', command: `/领取礼包奖励 ${tier.tierAmountYuan}` }]);
      } else if (tier.status === 'claimed') {
        md.addText(`${tier.tierAmountYuan}元档 ✓已领取`);
        md.addNewline();
      } else {
        md.addText(`${tier.tierAmountYuan}元档 未解锁`);
        md.addNewline();
      }

      md.addText(`  ${tier.rewardText}`);
    }

    md.addNewline();
    md.addText('💡礼包奖励根据首次充值的金额解锁对应档位，首次充值30元可解锁全部档位！');

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('查询礼包奖励信息失败:', error);

    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText('查询失败，请稍后再试。');

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));
  }
});
